query: SELECT key_id AS "key_id!", count(*) AS "n!" FROM ( SELECT key_id FROM provider_credentials UNION ALL SELECT key_id FROM user_totp UNION ALL SELECT key_id FROM org_oidc UNION ALL SELECT key_id FROM mcp_connections UNION ALL SELECT oauth_client_secret_key_id FROM mcp_servers WHERE oauth_client_secret_key_id IS NOT NULL) k GROUP BY key_id ORDER BY key_id
